svg.title: Nested rent-burden thresholds, ACS 2024
svg.desc: ACS 2024 point estimates for Abilene, TX Metro Area. The percentage denominator is 20,842 computable renter-occupied units. Below 30%: 8,787 estimated units, 42.2%; 30.0–49.9%: 6,367 estimated units, 30.5%; 50% or more: 5,688 estimated units, 27.3%. The last two disjoint groups together are the 30%+ group: 12,055 estimated units, 57.8%. The 50%+ group is already included, so do not add the two thresholds. 2,591 not-computed units are excluded from that denominator; all renter-occupied units total 23,433. Derived percentage margins of error are not calculated. This is not an investment ranking.
